{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''prototype''' weapon was developed by [[Rythani Products]] on behalf of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at some point shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was stored in [[Prototype Lab A]] in the [[Rythani Products Building]] on [[Rydonni Prime]] before it was stolen by professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]]. Sconn was able to get away with its theft, but not before [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]] placed a tracking device on it on behalf of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Caerbellak]] in an attempt to find and destroy the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] cells they believed the weapon would be transported to.<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
